text:
mira: heads up — HF->Redwood conversion for new-chat-13b shows a nasty eval regression. diffs point to token-position shifts and weird attention patterns. anyone seen this combo of rope_scaling + sliding_window before?

sam: can you paste the converted `config.json`? also which quant/onnx path did you use?

mira: pasted key fields below (redacted):
```json
{
  "model_type": "gpt",
  "max_position_embeddings": 2048,
  "rope_scaling": {"factor": 1.5, "position": "relative"},
  "sliding_window": 256,
  "num_key_value_heads": 32
}
```

lee: quick checks — `sliding_window` in some HF configs means the *prefill/cache window* (i.e., how many tokens to reuse) but in our runtime it used to be treated as a stride. mismatch causes KV-cache indexing to shift when sequence>window. :thinking:

toni: also check the checkpoint metadata. converters sometimes drop explicit `num_key_value_heads` and rely on `num_attention_heads`. if the checkpoint weights had 40 kv heads but config says 32 you'll get attention slicing misalignment that looks like position corruption.

mira: i ran a parity dump — the checkpoint `attn.kv_proj.weight` shape suggests 40 kv heads. converter log showed a warning that `kv_head_override not provided, assuming 32` (weird).

alex: sounds like three simultaneous causes: (1) max_position_embeddings too small for some eval samples -> wrap/truncation, (2) rope_scaling semantics differ (relative vs fixed) so rotary phase gets scaled incorrectly, (3) kv-head mismatch. any one of those can degrade quality, together they explode. quick triage steps: 
- verify `max_position_embeddings >= longest_eval_len` (or patch eval to shorter sequences).
- check checkpoint meta: `python -c "from transformers import AutoConfig;print(AutoConfig.from_pretrained('path').to_json_string())"`
- inspect weights: `python -c "import torch;w=torch.load('pytorch_model.bin',map_location='cpu');print([k for k in w.keys() if 'kv_proj' in k][:10])"`
- re-run conversion adding `--override-kv-heads 40` (or set `num_key_value_heads` in the config to match)

sam: good checklist. For rope_scaling we historically accepted either `{"factor":x}` or an explicit schedule. If HF uses `relative` position scaling we need to convert to our runtime style: try clearing `rope_scaling` in config to see if behaviour returns to baseline (i.e., fallback to no scaling).

lee: small repro: run eval with `--trace-kv` enabled in runtime. you'll see when keys get appended and whether the position idx resets. helps nail whether it's sliding_window vs max_pos.

toni: FYI I hit this last quarter with a smaller model — the fix was to set `max_position_embeddings` to 4096 (model was trained with longer contexts even though config said 2048) and to set `rope_scaling` to the converter-produced explicit matrix (not relative). after that, perplexity and ROUGE returned to expected.

mira: i'll try 3 things in order: bump max_pos to 4096 (smoke), force kv-heads to 40 in config and reconvert, and disable rope_scaling to isolate. will report numbers.

alex: if you need to keep sliding_window semantics, add a short note in the model card and a converter flag `--sliding-window-mode=<stride|prefill>` so we don't mismatch semantics later. PR welcome.

mira: filing a ticket with minimal repro + logs: INF-4821. attaching eval plots after runs. thanks all. :heart:

deploy-bot: created INF-4821 and linked pipeline run 247-evl-009. build logs -> https://ci.redwood/247-evl-009/logs

sam: great. if the reconvert fixes it we should add a unit in our conversion test: mismatch kv-heads + rope_scaling relative -> fail conversion with explicit warning.

lee: agreed — conversion should refuse to silently assume kv-head counts. i can sketch a lint rule.

mira: quick update (later): bumping `max_position_embeddings` removed the wrapping errors, but quality still off until kv-heads were aligned. after forcing `num_key_value_heads=40` and reconverting, eval metrics are back in line. rope_scaling disabled had minor effect.

alex: awesome — please paste final `config.json` you shipped to the model card for future onboarding.

mira: will do and add converter flags in the PR.

deploy-bot: INF-4821 -> status: resolved (merged conversion fixes).
